package.description: The Pressure Volume Loop Analysis Module extends LabChart to provide the detection and analysis of ventricular pressure and volume data.

en-US.description: The Pressure Volume Loop Analysis Module extends LabChart to provide the detection and analysis of ventricular pressure and volume data.
en-US.longDescription: The Pressure Volume Loop Analysis Module extends LabChart to provide the detection and analysis of ventricular pressure and volume data. The module calculates and displays a wide range of cardiac function parameters, relationships and plots. The module can be used to analyze pre-recorded data or to analyze data as it is sampled.
en-US.name: ADInstruments PVLoop

zh-CN.description: PVLoop 模块扩展了 LabChart 的功能，提供心室压力与容积数据的检测分析能力。
zh-CN.longDescription: PVLoop 模块扩展了 LabChart 的功能，提供心室压力与容积数据的检测分析能力。该模块可计算并显示多种心功能参数、相关关系及图形化结果，既支持对预先记录的数据进行分析，也能实时处理采样数据。

package.longDescription: The Pressure Volume Loop Analysis Module extends LabChart to provide the detection and analysis of ventricular pressure and volume data. The module calculates and displays a wide range of cardiac function parameters, relationships and plots. The module can be used to analyze pre-recorded data or to analyze data as it is sampled.
package.name: ADInstruments PVLoop
